hero.headline: Engineering the Backbone of African AI
hero.subheadline: We invite world-class data center architects and engineers to join our technical consortium for the 1MW project.

sections.title: A Synergy of Expertise
sections.body: The technical partner is the 'intellectual engine' of the Kenya AI Compute project. This role focuses on the high-level design and ongoing technical optimization of the facility. Responsibilities include the selection of modular container vendors, the design of high-density cooling loops, and the orchestration of the 100G/400G network fabric. We look for partners who have a proven track record in High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments and who can bring innovative solutions to the challenges of tropical data center operations. By joining our consortium, technical partners gain a footprint in the world's fastest-growing digital market and participate in the revenue-sharing model of a vertically integrated infrastructure asset. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. items: Architecture: Modular Tier II/III design for extreme GPU densities.
Energy: Optimization of hybrid power plant-to-rack distribution.
Software: Implementation of DCIM and MLOps management layers.
Networking: Architecting the Spine-Leaf fabric and international IXP peering.
R&D: Testing next-gen liquid cooling solutions for Phase 3 scaling.
